screen_off_seconds.meaning: Sway display blanking timeout in seconds; zero disables it. Requires the owner Sway session.

sleep_seconds.meaning: Recognized but always refused: there is no idle sleep consumer.

power_button_action.meaning: Action to set for the logind power key.

power_profile.meaning: The exact name of a profile currently advertised by powerprofilesctl; choices are runtime-dependent.

charge_limit.meaning: Whether to enable conservation mode on hardware that exposes it.

battery_level.meaning: Recognized but always refused on write: this field is owned by the system.

battery_state.meaning: Recognized but always refused on write: this field is owned by the system.

lid_action.meaning: Recognized but always refused on write: this field is owned by the system.

payload.meaning: Supply at least one writable field. No individual field is mandatory, and an empty payload is refused.

changed.meaning: Whether a settings change was reported; false on a returned refusal or environment-only preview.

mutationPerformed.meaning: False before actuation or on a preview; on rollback failure, indicates unconfirmed compensation.

receiptPath.meaning: Path to the settings receipt written on a successful non-preview run.

receipt.meaning: Settings operation record: kind, field names, ok, changed, backups and commands.

dryRun.meaning: Present and true on the environment-only CADUCEUS_SETTINGS_DRY_RUN preview, not on the staff-envelope path.

commands.meaning: Would-be process and file operations for the environment-only preview.

observed.meaning: Nidus file witnesses with path and before/after digests when a file transaction ran.

could_change_to.meaning: Candidate file paths when the nidus writer participated.

attempt.meaning: Nidus transaction steps and field readbacks when available.

final_receipt.meaning: Nidus outcome when present; otherwise the shared stamp reports the stop outcome.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class when the shared front door catches an unhandled stop exception.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Fixed outcome tokens and open families for echoed input keys, exception classes and composite rollback failures. Preflight and receipt setup can pass through decoder, OS and owner lookup diagnostics verbatim; these are not stable refusal tokens. Success omits this top-level field.
